column1: > The Panel has no publishable source. It is not published under any module path
> the publishing rules allow, and openabstractions/polite-monitor is a different
> program with the same name. Its rows stay here because the package's file list is the
> question this file answers, and leaving them out would answer it wrongly.
> over_curl.hpp is the C++ package and bindings/download-over-curl is in no
> repository rule, so it publishes nowhere either.
> The four Python rows are gated on Dev for a different reason: they have a
> publishable source and no way to reach it from a package assembled out of
> published module versions, which is what the release builds. Those two
> packages publish on their own registry, and a redistributable carrying a
> second copy of them would be one file with two homes — the same answer
> posix/payload.tsv gives. A build handed --src job and --src download carries
> them; the release is not, and says so.
